name: Yashiki Kazuo
source:
A middle-aged man who lost his memory. He arrived at the house as if something was inviting him. It is there he will understand the «Cursed Fate» that is engraved upon him.

[Edited from [url=http://gematsu.com/2017/01/death-mark-first-details-screenshots]Gematsu - Japanese Video Game News[/url]]

[spoiler]His true name is Masamune Kujou, he is a brother of Saya Kujou.[/spoiler]
